items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: That was right after Huey Long came in there and put all of these loan sharks out of business.

ctx.x: Oh, I never did understand what happened to the Owls after you left. The trumpet player kept it.

And how long did it last? He didn't last very long over there. Because he went back to the business there. That was right after Huey Long came in there and put all of these loan sharks out of business. But Bill kept it up with his brother-in-law. That they'd lend you half a dollar on Monday. They had this black trade down there. They'd lend you half a dollar on Monday. And you gave them back 75 cents on a Friday on payday. And Bill said, well, I spoke to him after that. But I didn't want to have anything personal…
